### `class AnvilMenuMixin` — `src/main/java/firearms/mixin/AnvilMenuMixin.java`
Closes `WEAPON-FAIL-006`, the residual gap `docs/spec/decisions/DEC-017-no-detach-durability.md` names and does not close by component omission alone: vanilla AnvilMenu.createResult() carries a second, independent repair path that combines two ItemStacks of the exact same net.minecraft.world.item.Item — checked by identity and isDamageableItem() only, never ItemStack.isValidRepairItem(ItemStack) — and restores durability to the first from the second regardless of whether either stack carries DataComponents.REPAIRABLE (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` `WEAPON-REQ-014`).
